days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Runde
stops.detail: The island's approximately 100 inhabitants are distributed between the villages of Runde and Goksøyr.

stops.name: Goksøyr
stops.detail: In addition to a campsite in Goksøyr, numerous private rooms and holiday apartments offer accommodation to the visitor.

stops.name: Rundebrua
stops.detail: The island is connected to the neighboring island of Remøya by a bridge (Rundebrua) and is therefore very easily accessible.

stops.name: Rundabranden
stops.detail: However, the 294 m high "Rundabranden" in the west of the island is Norway's southernmost large bird cliff according to the "Store Norske Leksikon".

stops.name: Runde fyr
stops.detail: In the northwest of the island is the lighthouse Runde fyr, which can be reached via a hiking trail from Goksøyr.
